svg.title: Attempt Participation renewal, reconnect, expiry, and re-allow timeline
svg.desc: Secure admission creates Participation generation one, one Connection, and a server-owned renewal interval and lease. Monotonic authenticated renewals extend the PostgreSQL lease; WebSocket ping does not. A brief reconnect before exclusive expiry may retain the generation. At expiry the old generation and Connection are permanently fenced, neutral Connection Loss evidence and one Flag are retained, and the Attempt is suspended. Manager re-allow returns it to Ready; fresh admission creates generation two.
